data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for streaming radio with background playback and lock‑screen controls.
data.what_it_does: Plays online radio streams on Android and iOS, supporting background audio, media controls, and metadata extraction. Provides a queue of sources with navigation and volume control.
use_when: You need continuous radio streaming with background playback
You want lock‑screen and notification media controls without writing platform code
avoid_when: You only need simple one‑off audio playback
You require advanced audio processing like equalization
strengths: Supports lock‑screen, notification, CarPlay, Android Auto, and watchOS
Typed source model and stream‑based state updates
weaknesses: Limited to streaming radio URLs (no local files)
No built‑in support for playlists beyond simple queue
Relies on platform permissions and manifest changes
data.setup_notes: Add INTERNET, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permissions to AndroidManifest.xml; enable Audio/Background Modes in iOS Signing & Capabilities and optionally allow arbitrary HTTP loads in Info.plist.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of audio features including local files, playlists, and more mature API, but requires manual background setup.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers extensive audio capabilities, gapless playback, and advanced audio processing; suitable if you need more than simple radio streaming.
